svg.title: O3R335 clearance area — top and side views
svg.desc: O3R335 clearance area with boundaries starting at the camera housing edges, without an offset. Angles are measured from the front-face plane: 24 degrees in the top view and 36 degrees in the side view. The central dimension runs perpendicular from the center of the camera front face to the end plane, 300 mm away. Both clearance views use 0.7 drawing units per millimeter; the front-view inset retains its enlarged reference scale. The pale red region is the clearance area, not the optical field of view. The area labeled Behind camera is behind the front-face plane; unshaded areas do not certify a chassis or mounting area.
